How to play

  1. Swipe the card in any direction to strike the goblins on it. Arrow keys work too.
  2. Every kill drops goblin ears. Tap Sell to turn them into gold, ideally during a price surge.
  3. Spend gold in the Shop. Killing more goblins raises your hunter level, which unlocks new upgrades.
  4. Hire adventurers. Each one fights on a card of their own. Keep swiping to build a frenzy and they hit harder.
  5. Tap golden goblins when they dash past. Kill swift goblins within 5 seconds or they run off with the card.
  6. Reach one billion kills and the King has to let you marry the Princess. The game pauses whenever you leave it.

Paused

Story so far

Endless mode

The Goblin King scratches one long green ear.

“Yeah, you found me out. But still… maybe you could help with the whole eldritch horror mess I made?”

Down in the Abyss, every goblin type comes back as a spawn of the thing below, with 50× the HP. New upgrade tiers unlock as you go. The goal: one trillion.

One trillion. The deep is quiet.

True ending. The last of the spawn sinks back into the dark, and the door grinds shut. Up in the castle, the Goblin King takes off his crown and hands it to the Princess. Down in the caves, the goblins put down their spears for the first time in thirty years.

At the wedding, the guest list is a little greener than planned.

The perfect match

You are rich, charming, and from exactly the right neighbouring kingdom. The Princess adores you. There is no reason this wedding shouldn’t happen.

Except one: the King does not want to let go of his daughter.

“Kill one billion goblins.”

“Then you may marry her,” says the King, extremely smug. “Trillions live in the caves below. They are very weak. This should be… quick.”

He thinks it’s impossible. He has never met an idle game.

The wedding

You walk back up into the light. The Goblin King, ears bare and crown in his hands, keeps his word. The Princess takes yours.

Bells ring across the castle. Far below, something huge turns over in its sleep. The goblins hold the door with a few more hands than yesterday, and that is a problem for another day.

Main ending unlocked. You can still go down and fight the horror any time from Settings.

Abandon the quest?
